items.title: Is Bio-Techne (TECH) Above Fair Value After A 44% Return?
items.summary: Bio-Techne stock has delivered a strong 44.2% return over the past year, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples currently point to the shares trading at a premium rather than as an obvious bargain. Over the last 12 months, Bio-Techne has returned 44.2%, which puts a clear spotlight on whether recent gains already reflect much of the good news in the price.
